issues.quote: Total assets climbed to $106.6 billion at fiscal 2023 year-end from $62.1 billion in fiscal 2022
issues.problem: Tesla's FY2022 total assets were about $82.3B; $62.1B is the FY2021 figure. Actual growth was about 29%, not about 72%.

data.summary: Revenue, net income, liabilities, cash and operating cash flow figures are correct. The FY2022 total assets figure is wrong ($82.3B, not $62.1B), which makes the balance-sheet expansion look much larger than it was.
